FINAL ANSWER: p = 8.10e-194

(headline = 3x3 omnibus Pearson chi-square test of independence, correction=False, on pd.crosstab(m6A, DEG) over all 12,754 records, df = 4)

OBSERVED table (rows = m6A status, cols = DEG status; N = 12,754, no rows dropped)
                 Down    Up   no-DEGs
  m6A Hyper         12   106      562
  m6A Hypo         119     9      383
  m6A no sig       284   433    10,846

EXPECTED under independence: [[22.13, 29.22, 628.66], [16.63, 21.96, 472.42], [376.25, 496.83, 10689.93]]
- minimum expected count = 16.6273; 0/9 cells < 5 and 0/9 < 1 → chi-square approximation valid, Fisher not required (and undefined for 3x3 in scipy)
- chi2 = 901.4452328658433, dof = 4
- p (scipy float64 repr) = np.float64(8.100776480858902e-194); 17 sig digits = 8.1007764808589021e-194; log10(p) = -193.091473
- Precision check requested in point 4: this is a TRUE float64 value, not a machine-precision floor — p is finite, > 0, and 114 orders of magnitude above np.finfo(float).tiny (2.225e-308). Independent recomputation via the regularized incomplete gamma gammaincc(dof/2, chi2/2) returns the identical value (abs diff 0.000e+00), and the asymptotic log-scale chi2 tail agrees (log10 P ≲ -193.1). A fixed-margin conditional Monte-Carlo (20,000 tables sampled from the multivariate hypergeometric) produced 0/20,000 tables with chi2 ≥ 901.4, i.e. p_MC ≤ 5e-5 — reported only as an "undetectably small" bound; the reported number is the analytic chi-square p, no exponent was fabricated.
- Reported at 3 significant figures: 8.10e-194 (2 s.f. 8.1e-194, 4 s.f. 8.101e-194). Row/column ordering of the crosstab was verified not to affect the result (identical p for the un-reindexed crosstab).

SENSITIVITY CHECKS (explicitly NOT the answer, both agree directionally):
1. Collapsed 2x2 "any m6A change (1,191)" x "any DEG (963)": observed [[10846, 717], [945, 246]], min expected 89.93, chi2 = 323.17, dof = 1, p = 2.95e-72 (Fisher exact cross-check 8.22e-54).
2. Unique genes (ENSG, N = 3,117, "any record significant"): [[130 m6A+DEG, 255 m6A-only], [421 DEG-only, 2311 neither]], min expected 68.06, chi2 = 78.13, dof = 1, p = 9.63e-19 (Fisher 2.96e-16).

BIOLOGICAL STRUCTURE (descriptive, from standardized residuals): the omnibus rejection is driven by concordant direction — m6A Hypo x Down observed/expected = 7.16x (std. residual +25.1) and m6A Hyper x Up = 3.63x (+14.2), with m6A Hypo x Up depleted (9 observed vs 22.0 expected, O/E 0.41). So gains of m6A accompany transcriptional up-regulation and losses accompany down-regulation.

AUDIT / EXCLUSIONS as agreed: m6A_DEG verified programmatically to equal f"{m6A} and {DEG}" for every one of the 12,754 rows → derived intersection, never used as an axis; zero missing values and zero non-standard tokens (NA/-/empty) confirmed inside the script, so no filtering or imputation; no |log2FC| or p<0.05 re-thresholding applied; Up-only/Hyper-only subsets not used; Proteomic_data .xlsx excluded (proteomics-only, contains no m6A variable, different gene universe — contextual only); the row-index-12 GeneID/GeneID.1 annotation mis-alignment is confined to the unused annotation block.

LIMITATION (one line, does not change the headline): rows are transcript/peak records (9,473 unique ENST / 3,117 unique ENSG), so the 3x3 treats repeated transcripts as independent — the gene-level de-duplicated sensitivity test still rejects strongly (p = 9.63e-19), so the conclusion is robust to that granularity choice.
